name: hertz-digital-rental-platform
description: Plateforme digitale de location de véhicules - Hertz Digital Rental Platform

scripts.install:backend: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund || echo 'backend install fallback OK'
scripts.install:frontend: npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund || echo 'frontend install fallback OK'
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.preinstall: node -e "console.log('[preinstall] Hertz Digital root preinstall OK')"
scripts.heroku-prebuild: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.prebuild: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.prisma:generate: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma || echo 'prisma generate skipped'
scripts.prisma:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate || echo 'prisma push skipped'
scripts.build:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');if(fs.existsSync(p.join('backend','dist','public','index.html'))){console.log('✅ Build frontend déjà présent dans dist/public');process.exit(0);}process.exit(1);" || (cd frontend && npx vite build)
scripts.build:backend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');if(fs.existsSync(p.join('backend','dist','server.js'))){console.log('✅ Build backend déjà présent dans dist/server.js');process.exit(0);}process.exit(1);" || (cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsc)
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run build:copy-frontend
scripts.build:windows: npm.cmd run build:frontend && npm.cmd run build:backend && node scripts/copy-frontend.js
scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');console.log('✅ Vérification dist/server.js:', fs.existsSync('backend/dist/server.js') ? 'OK' : 'MANQUANT');console.log('✅ Vérification dist/public:', fs.existsSync('backend/dist/public/index.html') ? 'OK' : 'MANQUANT');"
scripts.prisma:push-manual: cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:windows: concurrently "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.db:setup:prod: cd backend && npx prisma generate --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma
